evidence: Modifies CMakeLists.txt to enable and enforce the -Wmissing-noreturn compiler warning flag.
rationale: Enforcing -Wmissing-noreturn prevents compiler false positives such as spurious missing-return warnings across platforms. As noted in the description, "Missing [[noreturn]] attributes can cause compiler false positives and other issues", making this a worthwhile hygiene improvement for the compiler warning suite.
